desc: This elevated hotel features a scenic garden pavilion restaurant for stylish Thai cooking.
addr: M G, The Oberoi Bengaluru, 37-39, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: I feel Rim Naam's class is loosing its class. I have been a customer here for last 3 years and get my foreign guests here. This time I had a sub-par experience …

We came here for dinner and had a mixed experience. Unfortunately it was raining loads which is totally outside of the restaurants control but it meant the atmosphere was tainted and there were lots of mosquitos around. Beyond the weather …

Rim Naam at The Oberoi, MG Road, is a masterclass in fine dining that feels far removed from the city’s bustle. The ambiance is truly breathtaking; walking over a wooden pathway across a serene koi pond into a lush, tropical pavilion …
